basic_details.job_title: Zila Panchayat Jashpur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 9 Accountant, Computer Programmer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Zila Panchayat Jashpur is recruiting candidates for 9 vacancies for Computer Programmer (District Level), Programme Officer (District Level), Assistant Programmer (District Level), and Accountant (District / Block Level) posts on a contract basis. Eligible applicants must apply through the prescribed offline process by sending the completed application form through Registered Post or Speed Post to the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Jashpur, Chhattisgarh on or before 30 October 2026. The notified monthly pay is Rs. 51,780 for Computer Programmer, Rs. 39,875 for Programme

age_limit.details: Minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years as on 01.01.2026. General Administration Department rules provide age relaxation up to 45 years for local residents of Chhattisgarh who are regular government servants, public sector/board/corporation/contract employees/ex-servicemen. An additional 5 years of age relaxation applies to local educated unemployed youth of Chhattisgarh under departmental norms, provided the total relaxation does not exceed 45 years. | FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their filled application forms through Registered Post or Speed Post only. Personal submissions or direct applications will not be accepted. Applications must be sent to the following address: Office of the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Jashpur, Chhattisgarh, PIN 496331 Envelope Instructions: The name of the applied post and category must be clearly written on top of the envelope, otherwise the application will be rejected. Separate applications must be submitted for each post if applying for more than one.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Jashpur Computer Programmer Job Description
content_sections.text: The positions are established under the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Mission (VB-G RAM G) (Gramin) at Zila Panchayat Jashpur to handle programmatic, computer programming, and accounting tasks at district and block levels on a contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of all mark sheets and certificates Passport-size photograph affixed on the application form and self-attested Self-addressed envelope with Rs. 30 postage stamp affixed Caste certificate issued by a competent authority (for reserved categories) Domicile certificate of Chhattisgarh Verified experience certificates from government rural development schemes containing office order numbers, dates, and order numbers/dates of No Objection from employers where applicable PH certificate issued by a Medical Board (if applicable) Verified certificate for Jashpur-domiciled Bhutanese or displaced persons (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on academic qualification weightage, practical computer tests, and experience marks. Merit lists are prepared and candidates are called for a skill test. For each vacancy, 10 candidates will be called based on merit ranking. Final selection combines academic/experience weightage and practical test scores. No waiting list is maintained beyond the reserve candidates formed during selection.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in Zila Panchayat Jashpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies across Computer Programmer, Programme Officer, Assistant Programmer, and Accountant posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit offline applications is 30 October 2026 up to 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline via Registered Post or Speed Post to the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Jashpur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 35 years as on 01.01.2026, with relaxations up to 45 years for eligible local residents and government/contract employees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the Computer Programmer post?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary for the Computer Programmer post is Rs. 51,780.

faq.question: Q6. Are applicants required to pay any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit in educational qualifications and experience, followed by a practical computer test.

faq.question: Q8. Is this job permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The appointments are made strictly on a contract basis under the VB-G RAM G scheme and can be terminated at any time without prior notice.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but candidates must submit separate applications with separate envelopes for each post.
